1879060250.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory
1879060250.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879089818.name: Dúnedain Mark
1879089818.desc: When marked as a prey of one of the Dúnedain, their wrath is terrible.

1879092634.name: Blade of Elendil
1879092634.desc:
An attack that does Light damage with an increased Critical chance.

Requires Battle-hardened State.

Fellows within range gain the Light of Elendil, enabling them to deal additional Light damage.

This attack never misses and cannot be blocked, parried or evaded.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

DNT - Blade of Elendil causes next attack against you to deal less damage
DNT - Blade of Elendil causes Shadow's Lament to deal more damage

DNT - Devastating Blow, Light of Elendil, Routing Cry have a chance to trigger an Evade rating buff
DNT - Critical Heals with Inspire and Valiant Strike cause your Song-brother's next Heal to Crit.

1879094938.name: Call of Oromë
1879094938.desc: Requires Dissonance Stance.\n\nDeals AoE Light damage and reduces Light damage resistance.

procEffects.description: Damaging skills have a  *  chance to make your next healing skill crit.
Scoring a Critical Hit increases Outgoing Healing by 10% for 10s. You cannot gain this effect more than once every 25s.

1879112986.name: Evasion
1879112986.desc: Your Archer can increase their evasion abilities for a short time.

1879115290.name: Elven Enemy
1879115290.desc: When you are an enemy of the Eldar, you cannot avoid their unflinching gaze.  This skill is the pre-requisite for Archer's Strike.

1879134362.name: Fist and Spear
1879134362.desc: Mastery over the Fist: Allows Warden to perform Fist Gambits quickly.

1879136794.name: Revenge
1879136794.desc: When your target has less than a quarter of their morale, you can make an extremely damaging attack.

1879200538.name: Blade Toss
1879200538.desc: You hurl your blades at your opponent, dealing significant damage and hampering them when attacking from behind.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Deals increased damage and applies a slow when attacking from behind.</rgb>

1879201690.name: Snare
1879201690.desc: You quickly toss a snare onto the ground, slowing up to 3 targets and allowing you to escape to a safe distance.

1879209882.name: Steed of the Champion
1879209882.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the champion.

1879215002.name: Improved Staff Sweep
1879215002.desc: Sweeps the staff to strike surrounding foes.\n\nFor each enemy hit, you receive a buff to Crit Chance for your next Fire Skill.

1879231258.name: Shield and Javelin
1879231258.desc: Mastery over the Shield: Allows Warden to perform Shield Gambits quickly.

1879241626.name: Hammer of Rohan
1879241626.desc: When called to action, the people of Rohan can smite their enemies with fierce cruelty and unnrelenting wrath.

1879244826.name: Dash
1879244826.desc: Your steed pushes itself beyond normal limits, increasing its speed for a short period of time.

1879260058.name: Distracting Shot
1879260058.desc: A shot that dazes the target.

1879260314.name: Bond of the Lore-master
1879260314.desc: The bond of the Lore-master is strong. With it, allies may benefit from an increased knowledge of beasts and the natural world alike.

1879261978.name: Cry Vengeance
1879261978.desc: When an enemy is defeated, you let out a Cry that restores a small amount of morale to you and your allies.

1879266842.name: Stealth
1879266842.desc: The Rangers of the North have always been skilled at becoming unseen when they wish to be.

1879275290.name: Unbreakable
1879275290.desc: The Champion empowers themselves by releasing a mighty cry. Each time they are hit, they grow tougher.

1879311258.name: Rush
1879311258.desc: You erupt into a sprint, gaining ground quickly on your foes.

1879341722.name: Steed of the Eldar
1879341722.desc: A steed worthy of the Eldar.

1879366938.name: Elk of Felegoth's Night
1879366938.desc: A mighty Lasgalen elk, garbed to blend in with the night.

1879414298.name: Yule Gala Steed
1879414298.desc: A steed dressed in the finest Yule raiment.

1879457562.name: Rapid Techniques
1879457562.desc: In times of need, wardens are able to rapidly speed up their foundational techniques.\n\nThe skill will remove your mastery skill cooldowns for 6 seconds while reducing your power costs.

1879466266.name: Sail to Buckland
1879466266.desc: Navigate to Buckland with nearby fellows.

1879485338.name: Taupe Hamster
1879485338.desc: Summons an adorable hamster to keep you company.

1879488026.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Belegaer Gull)
1879488026.desc: Summons an eagle-type companion.\n\nThis is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879506586.name: Glaciate
1879506586.desc: Emit a burst of ice beneath your target, damaging and rooting any enemies struck.

1879508634.name: Marsh Scorpion
1879508634.desc: Summons a marsh scorpion to accompany you on your travels.

1879522074.name: Laundry Day
1879522074.desc: Summons an odious cloud around you, letting people know it's laundry day.

1879523994.name: On the Hunt
1879523994.desc: Blow a clear note on a hunting horn, restoring Morale to weakened allies and restoring Power to those less injured.
